aboutDetail:
An independent music client built with MyGo.
Music and accounts are provided by YouTube Music.

Global play / pause: ⌘ / Ctrl + Shift + Space
Closing the window keeps music playing; press ⌘ / Ctrl + Q to quit.

signOutMessage: Sign out and clear local account data?
signOutDetail:
Playback stops, the sign-in window closes, and ytmgo clears every account's sign-in state, cookies, web storage and cache on this device.
Your appearance and language settings and your cloud library are kept. Other browsers stay signed in.

@accountWindowTitle.description: Title of the sign-out progress window.

@logoutBusyLabel.description: Accessible name of the progress spinner.

@logoutFailedTitle.description: Sign-out status title after a failure.

logoutFailedDetail: Try again. The music view stays closed until clearing finishes; your settings are kept.
logoutDoneDetail: Sign-in state, cookies, web storage and cache for every account in this app are cleared. Your settings and cloud library are kept.
